locator.text: Display 111.1, p. 111, in the proof of Proposition 9.6

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Recovery: the membership and the exponent identity are two declarations in Lean and one display in the paper. rankStage_gain_of_targets (and rankStage_defect_class) give ∀ i, UnweightedClass … (H + 9/10 - 2κ) of the three debt rows after the rank stage — the display's left-hand side, with S_α encoded as UnweightedClass at α on the local slow strip and the row order (P, Jθ, Jz) fixed by CorrectionState.debt. Substituting H := meanUpdateExponent σ κ and applying ExponentLedger.rank_defect_gain_identity rewrites the exponent to C_* + 9/10 - 4κ, which is the display's equality. Lean adds hypotheses the paper leaves to its standing conventions (hH : 9/10 ≤ H, the target classes at H, support and smoothness of the rank increment); the conclusion carries, in addition, the radial-error bound MeanClass … (H + 9/10 - 2κ) (actualRadialError …), which is the paper's preceding sentence about subtracting 2VΔv/R from Δg_r and is more than the display asserts.
